currency_convention: All amounts are synthetic INR values. A real integration should keep the source currency and conversion timestamp beside each event.
privacy: Every applicant, provider, reference and transaction in this pack is fictional and generated for product demonstration only.
overlap_policy: Rows are intentionally unique across files. A source may describe the same broad financial pattern as another source, but no exact date/event/amount/currency/direction fingerprint is duplicated.

expected_outcome.label: strong / low risk
why: Six months of regular salary plus a small, consistent platform income stream
Rent, utilities, insurance and asset instalments have explicit due and paid dates
Positive balances and reserve transfers are visible
Remittances and multiple evidence types show a clear cross-border pattern

sources.purpose: Net salary, everyday outflows, reserve transfers and running balances.
Independent gross-payroll record; dates and amounts are not exact duplicates of the bank rows.
Recurring housing commitment with due and paid dates.
Recurring household utility bills with due and paid dates.
Secondary platform earnings, separate from salary.
Inbound remittances normalized to INR for the demo.
Equipment instalments with due and paid dates.
Protection-premium history with due and paid dates.
Mobile-wallet reserve top-ups and a small service spend.

expected_outcome.label: mixed / manual review
expected_outcome.review_route: ask for more context before deciding
why: Only three months of records are available
Income is split between salary and merchant settlements with a missed month
One rent payment has no due-date evidence and another was late
Balances stay positive, but the short and uneven history limits confidence

sources.purpose: Short bank history with salary, spending and balances.
Three rent observations with one missing due date and one late payment.

expected_outcome.label: weak / high risk
expected_outcome.review_route: needs remediation or a smaller exposure
why: Pay declines across the six-month window and platform income is sporadic
Rent, utilities and equipment instalments consume most observed inflows
Several obligations are paid after their due dates
The bank balance becomes negative and no reserve, insurance or remittance buffer is observed

sources.purpose: Declining contract pay, household outflows and negative running balances.
Partial payroll record for the first three months only.
Housing payments with repeated late dates.
Utility bills with repeated late dates.
Equipment instalments with repeated late dates.
